tags.name: Great Lawn
tags.note: This might look like an subjective term for an ordinary patch of grass, but it's actually named in the master plan layout of Gardens of Spring Creek seen on a sign in front, March 2020.  Honestly from the satellite imagery, I've seen better lawns...
This is a guess based on ESRI imagery on Larimer GIS.  This may be wrong, awaiting newer imagery for verification.
